title: Results contract 1.5.0 (additive, optional): rear-yard checks, constraint lines, envelope rows, illustrative placement, input facts on the nine bases, and the area allocation; version sets in both validators and the web reader
objective: One additive, optional revision of the results contract to 1.5.0 (names fixed at G0 from work order v2 task M5-T164): (a) rear-yard checks for ZR 23-344 (a), (b) and (c)(3), each with state applies/not_applicable/not_known, inputs (name, value, unit, basis), conditions, text and zr_sections; a not_known check carries no number; a combined rear-yard row with its way and conditions; (b) geometry.constraint_lines (the (b) 100-ft line, the corner area, the 8-ft street-wall band, the setback line), each with state, basis and zr_sections, geometry only when established; (c) envelope rows: setback, street wall, side yard; (d) building_alternatives[].placement: status, label const 'Illustrative', outline only when placed, method, basis, measure with its conversion statement (G-14), conditions, checks, not_checked; (e) optional floor_plates.entries[].building; (f) input_facts: key, value, unit, basis (closed enum equal to the nine QUANTITY_BASES of tools/research_record_check.py:51), source title, source date; (g) building_alternatives[].area_allocation: label const 'Illustrative', one share (minimum 0.60, maximum 0.75), the measure in the estimate's own vocabulary (preliminary_apartment_estimate.py), the conversion statement, apartment-area, other-area and total sq ft, a fitted flag, conditions; no zone geometry, unit count or core position; (h) version sets: CONTRACT_VERSIONS_WITH_WAY_LAYER (results_way_rules.py:36) and the web SUPPORTED_RESULTS_CONTRACT_VERSIONS (results-contract-checks.ts:51) gain '1.5.0'. Checks use only oneOf, const, additionalProperties:false, minimum/maximum (KNOWN_KEYWORDS has no if/then/not). Both schema copies identical; results.ts regenerated with packages/contracts/scripts/generate_ts_types.py.
business_reason: The rear-yard, envelope, placement and area-illustration tasks of waves 25-27 need a contract shape that keeps not-known values without numbers and illustrative geometry labelled, before any engine emits them.

acceptance_scenarios.when: it is validated against the 1.5.0 schema

acceptance_scenarios.then: they pass: a conditional rear yard with its checks and the (b) line; envelope rows; a placed and a withheld placement; input_facts; a fitted and an unfitted area_allocation

acceptance_scenarios.given: a withheld or not_known row with a number, a withheld placement with an outline, an allocation with zone geometry
acceptance_scenarios.then: each is rejected, using only oneOf, const, additionalProperties:false

acceptance_scenarios.given: a placement or allocation label other than 'Illustrative'
an input fact with a basis outside the nine
acceptance_scenarios.then: it is rejected, and a test asserts the enum equals QUANTITY_BASES
it must declare 1.5.0; the two schema copies are identical; results.ts is regenerated

acceptance_scenarios.when: it is compared with the 1.4.0 fixture it came from
acceptance_scenarios.then: it is that drawable fixture plus only the new blocks

acceptance_scenarios.given: the fan-out consumers (test_report_pages ALL_FIXTURES, test_results_*_slot, test_results_way_rules, test_study_contracts, the kit and CAD snapshot fan-out, kit test_adapter, the web results-fixtures consumers)
acceptance_scenarios.when: they run at the rebased head
acceptance_scenarios.then: they are green and unedited (except the named snapshots and NOT_DRAWABLE_FIXTURES if needed)

acceptance_scenarios.when: it reads 1.5.0 and an unknown version
acceptance_scenarios.then: it accepts 1.5.0 and still rejects unknown versions

acceptance_scenarios.given: a 1.5.0 document that breaks a way-layer rule
acceptance_scenarios.when: both Python validators and the web checks read it
acceptance_scenarios.then: all three refuse it; 1.3.0 and 1.4.0 behaviour is unchanged

acceptance_scenarios.given: an allocation with share outside 0.60-0.75, or without its measure or conversion statement

risks: If the shape proves too small later, a 1.6.0 revision is needed before M5-T170/M5-T172; G1 checks the shapes against NB-03, NB-04, NB-06, the nine bases, G-14 and R091.
packages/contracts/** is also listed by the dormant claimed task M5-T125 (2026-09-30, no producer, never progressed); later waves edited these files without it; no producer is running on it.
path_notes: Fixture and snapshot names fixed here (synthetic_*_contract_1_5_0 sorts after recorded_215_16_northern_journey.json, so test_study_contracts' first file is unchanged). New fixture and snapshot files are not seeded: a placeholder would break the fixture-iterating tests.

cd apps/web && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npx vitest run src/lib/__tests__/results-contract-checks.test.ts
